items.title: 14.4.11 Bhari dhatein (lead, mercury aur cadmium) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.4.11, printed page 310.

blocks.text: Lead, mercury aur cadmium jaisi bhari dhatein aham air pollutants ho sakti hain. Yeh sanati amal, transport aur doosri insani sargarmiyon se fiza mein chhori jati hain; dhaat-sazi (metallurgy), battery ka koora aur jalana (incineration) un ke bare zaraye hain.

blocks.prompt: Fiza mein bhari dhaton ke bare zaraye kya hain, aur lead aur mercury ki aaloodgi ke zaraye bayan karein (Quick Check 14.2d; exercise Q.2m).
blocks.explanation: Dhaat-sazi (ores ka pighlana aur saaf karna), batteries ka koora aur recycling, aur koore ka jalana, saath transport aur doosri sanat. Lead lead pighlane, lead-acid battery recycling aur pehle leaded petrol se aati hai; mercury coal jalne, mercury wale koore aur jalane, aur dhaat aur chlor-alkali sanaton se.

items: Bhari dhatein Pb, Hg, Cd dhaat-sazi, battery ke koore, jalane, transport aur sanat se.
